segmentDefinitions.RECENT_FIRST_SALE_PROXY: first observed sale is within 60 days of the forecast origin; not a verified creation date
segmentDefinitions.WEEKLY_PATTERN_PROXY: seven training weekdays, mean >= 1 unit/day, positive minimum weekday mean, max/min >= 1.7
segmentDefinitions.STABLE_HIGH: mean >= 2 units/day, occurrence >= 60%, coefficient of variation <= 0.75

limitations: Unobserved stockouts may censor recorded sales; this dataset cannot evaluate lost demand.
New-item status is only proxied by first sale date because product creation dates are absent.
Weekly patterns are exploratory and do not establish annual seasonality from one year of data.
Model winners are selected on earlier validation folds and scored on later holdout folds; this is still one store and one 365-day window.
No true inventory, lead-time, expiry, or realized cost data is available for operational planning metrics.
